label: Simpler, faster sign-in
description: Getting into your portal is now a single step. Your session stays put across the web and the mobile app, so you spend less time logging in and more time on chapter business.

label: Give back in a couple of taps
description: Alumni can now see their giving history and make a donation to the chapter right from the dashboard — no more chasing down a separate link.

label: Edit your profile in-app
description: Update your contact details, photo, and preferences directly in the portal. Changes sync everywhere the chapter sees you.
